superseded_reason: Before any input seal or scientific solve, the all-retained-root residual gate was found to misclassify numerical splits of cleared-denominator multiple zero roots as physical Laurent roots. The v2 contract keeps every root but gates residuals only on deterministically matched physical roots and adds explicit unmatched-root safety gates.
purpose: Second isolated Python candidate for the five sealed author file-identity routes. Solver selection is preregistered solely by matrix order and never uses MATLAB rho, poles, stability, validator output, or any prior Step-5 scientific result.
path_base: parent directory of this contract's code directory
base_compute_usage: immutable dataclasses for contracted matrices and routes
compact scalar-delay and full-q ordinary-history matrix builders
normalized polynomial and direct-Laurent residual evaluators
forbidden_computation_inputs: any validator or diagnostic comparison result

manifest_field_policy.statement: The route manifest is read only for route identity, contracted matrix variable names, workspace path, and workspace SHA-256. No grid/result path or numerical Step-4 result is read.

rule.state: [q_k,q_(k-1),channel-1 scalar delay chain,channel-2 scalar delay chain]

matlab_storage_policy.array_restore: Every contracted numeric dataset is converted to float64 and transposed after h5py read.
matlab_storage_policy.right_division: M/al is computed only as scipy.linalg.solve(al.T,M.T).T; inverse and elementwise division are forbidden.

root_policy.raw_roots: Every ordinary eig root is stored, including nonfinite roots and all numerical splits of exact multiple zero roots.
root_policy.zero_root_rule: Only when clearing_power>0, a finite root is marked removed if abs(root)<=max(1e-12,100*eps*selected_solver_order*max(1,median(abs(finite_nonzero_roots)))).
root_policy.retained_roots: Every finite root above the fixed zero tolerance is retained. No root may be removed by theoretical multiplicity, root count, route identity, point identity, MATLAB comparison, or post hoc residual.
root_policy.rho: max(abs(retained_roots)); numerical origin splits remain in this maximum.
root_policy.all_root_residual_storage: Polynomial and direct-Laurent residual arrays are stored for every raw root. Direct Laurent residual is +Inf at z=0 and NaN for nonfinite roots; these exact cleared-denominator roots are not retained.
root_policy.retained_root_gate: Every retained root, including every numerical origin split above the fixed zero tolerance, must have finite polynomial and direct-Laurent residual no greater than 1e-8.
root_policy.origin_multiplicity_diagnostic: For full-q points, theoretical_extra_zero_count=full_q_order-compact_order; observed_zero_count is fixed-tolerance removal count; origin_splitting_shortfall_count=max(0,theoretical_extra_zero_count-observed_zero_count). The same number of smallest retained roots is flagged only as a diagnostic candidate set and is never removed or corrected.

modes.preflight: Read-only contract, dependency, manifest, workspace, route-order, forbidden-input, and failed-route checks; creates the immutable input_seal before any scientific solve.
modes.selftest: Deterministic synthetic checks of both order-selected algorithms and their residuals; requires the input seal.
modes.pilot: Exactly the preregistered real sealed-workspace points below; requires PASS preflight and selftest.
modes.full: Five independently recomputed 31x67 grids; never copies or reads the first Step-5 CSV/HDF5 results.
modes.resume: Resumes only a candidate full-grid checkpoint whose code, contract, dependency, manifest, and workspace hashes exactly match the input seal.

master_thesis_route.borrowing_policy: Do not substitute author-program or historical matrices.

manuscript_0824_route.borrowing_policy: Do not substitute author-program or historical matrices.

required_checks: full recomputation repeat when resource estimate remains practical
